description: This Java class defines a Fragment that manages two other fragments and their visibility based on user interactions with checkboxes. It demonstrates fragment lifecycle management and dynamic UI updates within an Android application.

classes.name: FragmentMenuFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages two nested fragments, providing options to show or hide them via checkboxes, demonstrating fragment transactions and UI updates.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, initializes child fragments if necessary, and sets up checkbox listeners.

methods.name: onViewStateRestored
methods.description: Ensures fragment visibility is correctly updated after the view state is restored.

methods.name: updateFragmentVisibility
methods.description: Updates the visibility of the child fragments based on the checkbox states.
